payload.reason: The evidence provides specific strategies for ensuring diverse cross-cultural representation in NLP models, including data sampling, group DRO, and careful data collection and annotation.

claims.text: To ensure diverse cross-cultural representation, apply data sampling techniques that prioritize minority cultures alongside majority cultures.
Implement Group Distributionally Robust Optimisation (group DRO) to optimize model performance across different cultural groups.
Focus on diverse data collection and annotation practices to represent multiple perspectives and sources in training datasets.
Utilize transfer learning to leverage knowledge from resource-rich languages and cultures to improve representation in low-resource settings.
